sources.excerpt: Pedal Finder Explore Brands Guides Pedalboards FAQ Home / Cosmic Sound FX / The MkII Cosmic Sound FX Prepare to be transported to the far reaches of the cosmic soundscape with Cosmic Sound FX's The MkII. This fuzz pedal is no mere distortion box - it's a portal to a mind-bending, psychedelic dimension where your guitar tone takes on a life of its own. At the heart of The MkII lies a carefully curated blend of germanium and silicon transistors, meticulously tuned to produce a rich, organic fuzz that's equal parts searing aggression and mesmerizing texture. Crank the Gain knob and let the pedal's gritty, almost sentient voice envelop your signal, transforming your guitar into a pulsating, otherworldly force. The Tone control allows you to sculpt the high-end response, dialing in everything from a warm, fuzzy crunch to a sizzling, harmonically-complex lead tone. But The MkII isn't just about raw power - it also offers a unique Modulation control that introduces a subtle, shimmering vibrato effect, adding an extra layer of cosmic mystique to your sound. This feature sets the pedal apart, allowing you to craft expansive, atmospheric textures that evoke the sonic landscapes of psychedelic pioneers like Jimi Hendrix and Syd Barrett. Whether you're looking to inject some mind-bending fuzz into your indie rock riffs or you want to venture into the outer limits of sonic exploration, Cosmic Sound FX's The MkII is a must-have for any guitarist seeking to expand their tonal horizons.
